descriptions.d27h_jetpack_tilt_800abd30: Jetpack tilt: flattens the velocity at +100; if its squared length is zero sets +156 to 0.5; otherwise rotates (0,0,1) by the yaw at +92 through 0x801f7538, normalizes both vectors, and stores the acos of their clamped dot divided by pi at +156, clamped to 0..1.
